title: Light becomes part of the scene.
description: Cover or expose the sensor to dim and brighten a virtual room, open its blinds, and change the motion of floating dust.
alt: Ambient Light Theater demo showing the physical sensor beside a responsive virtual room

title: Make visuals respond to presence.
description: Move a hand toward the sensor to grow a glowing bloom, brighten its core, and energize the particles around it.
alt: Proximity Bloom demo showing a hand-controlled glowing flower

title: Turn movement into a controller.
description: Rotate and tilt the sensor to steer a 3D cube. Orientation data connects physical movement to the scene on screen.
alt: Orientation Cube demo showing the sensor hardware and a colorful cube following its rotation

title: Explore interaction in three dimensions.
description: Move your hand above an 8×8 distance sensor and see its shape as a live point cloud. Use the same depth data for position, presence, or touchless instruments.
alt: Time-of-flight demo showing a hand above the sensor and its shape rendered as a 3D point cloud
